text:
The central conflict in the text is an ethical dilemma faced by Captain Reyes and her crew. They must choose between adhering to the "prime directive," which prohibits interfering with undeveloped civilizations, and acting on moral grounds to save an alien species whose planet is facing destruction. This creates an internal conflict within the crew as they debate the moral implications of inaction versus the consequences of violating their established rules.
